name: pacs.004 to MT103/MT202/MT205 RETN Field Mapping
description: Maps ISO 20022 pacs.004 PaymentReturnV09 fields to SWIFT MT103/MT202/MT205 RETN message structure according to CBPR+ reverse transformation specification

tasks.name: TR001: Extract Sender and Receiver BICs
tasks.description: Extract BIC codes from header for use in translation rules

tasks.name: Determine Target Message Type
tasks.description: Determine whether to generate MT103, MT202, or MT205 RETN based on return chain structure

tasks.name: Map SWIFT Message Headers
tasks.description: Map basic header and application header from MX header

tasks.name: Map User Header
tasks.description: Map user header fields including UETR

tasks.name: Map Basic MT Fields
tasks.description: Map core MT fields from pacs.004 elements

tasks.name: Map Ordering Customer (Field 50) for MT103
tasks.description: Map Return Chain Debtor Party to Field 50 for MT103 RETN

tasks.name: Map Ordering Institution (Field 50) for MT202/205
tasks.description: Map Return Chain Debtor Agent to Field 50 for MT202/205 RETN

tasks.name: Map Ordering Institution (Field 52)
tasks.description: Map Return Chain Debtor Agent to Field 52

tasks.name: Map Beneficiary Institution (Field 58) for MT202/205
tasks.description: Map Return Chain Creditor Agent to Field 58 for MT202/205 RETN

tasks.name: Map Beneficiary Customer (Field 59) for MT103
tasks.description: Map Return Chain Creditor Party to Field 59 for MT103 RETN

tasks.name: Map Return Reason Information (Field 72)
tasks.description: Map return reason and additional information to Field 72

tasks.name: Map Charge Bearer (Field 71A) for MT103
tasks.description: Map ChargeBearer to Field 71A for MT103 RETN

tasks.name: Generate Field Order
tasks.description: Generate the field order array based on target message type and present fields

tasks.name: Publish MT Return Message
tasks.description: Generate final MT103/MT202/MT205 RETN message from mapped fields
